serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Shanice: Yes. It wasn’t easy, but we did talk. 
Shanice: It was a good decision on your part to tell Priestbot about it.
You: Thank God…
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceHappy
Shanice: Very adequate choice of words for this place, don’t you think? 
You: Yeah!
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceNormal
You: So, to what conclusion have you two come to?
Shanice: How about I tell you after I ask Priestbot to come here? He’s at the back so it will take just a minute.
You: Sure.
